meta.purpose: How each custom property the 18.6.6 interface is built on maps onto the AIA design system (ADR 0013). build-skin.mjs turns this into the skin's variable layer. `token` names a colour token in src/design/tokens.json; `radius` / `font` name a radius token or a type family; `value` is a literal only where the design system decides the property is absent (`none`). A variable not listed here is left as 18.6.6 defines it, on purpose: see `left`.
meta.theme: light only. 18.6.6's final variable block forces light values under prefers-color-scheme: dark, and the interface hard-codes 328 colours a dark theme could not reach, so a skinned dark mode would be half dark. Dark follows once the hard-coded colours are covered (plan, Needs structure).

map.why: Page ground.
Panels and cards sit one step above the page, separated by a border, never by shadow.
Wells: table headers, inputs, secondary blocks.
The step rail is a well beside the workspace, not a card.
Hairline dividers. 192 uses: the most-used variable in the interface.
18.6.6 uses it for control borders (secondary buttons, inputs); the design system requires >= 3:1 there.
Primary text and every figure a conclusion rests on.
18.6.6's secondary heading ink; the design system has one primary ink.
Secondary text.
Tertiary text: hints, timestamps.
The one accent: primary action, links, selection, the live edge of a running process.
Accent text on accent washes (soft buttons); signal on signal-wash is a checked pair.
Primary action hover.
Soft action and selected-row ground.
Hover of a soft action.
The faintest accent ground, used for informational panels.
Same role as --brand2 in 18.6.6's scale.
Same role as --brand3 in 18.6.6's scale.
Decorative edge of accent-ground elements.
Done is quiet, not celebratory: the design system has no green in the status family. What is OK is said by the label and glyph 18.6.6 already prints.
A done or passing block is a neutral well, not a coloured one.

18.6.6's WARNING issues each name a fix step and a button a person must press (e.g. 'Upravit cílovku'): the design system's 'waiting on a person' family. Its amber ink and wash only; the solid amber fill is reserved for the viewer-actionability contract (OI-11) and never used by the skin.
See --warn.

See --bad.
Surfaces are separated by borders, never by shadow; only overlays carry shadow-overlay.
One radius scale: 0 / 2 / 4 px.

IBM Plex Mono for identifiers, fingerprints and ledger rows.

left.why: A provider's own identity colour on its badge (one use). AIA does not restyle another party's mark.
